summary: No change: submission.json contains only the rationale and adds no sources, investigations, knowledge, gaps, interpretations or experiment; validation of those bytes remains valid with no diagnostics. Every question this run opened is recorded as explained with a retained receipt or an explicit source-only basis, no necessary gap is open, each execution carries its interpretation, and the findings with counterevidence plus the sourced mechanism entries stand on the record. With the budget expiring in this turn, another experiment could not receive an interpretation and further entries would repeat recorded code, so the update is unchanged; expiry preserves the retained work and needs no closing call, leaving defect validity, CFT relevance and deduplication to human offline review.
